concepts.name: The Meaning Of Patriotism Patriotism Has
concepts.simple_definition: The meaning of patriotism Patriotism has originated from the Latin term ‘patria’ which means father land
concepts.deep_explanation: Therefore, patriotism is a sentiment; a psychological attachment to one’s nation
concepts.real_example: Practical example of The meaning of patriotism Patriotism has from page 149.
concepts.common_confusion: Students sometimes confuse The meaning of patriotism Patriotism has with adjacent topics in Chapter 7.
concepts.name_amharic: The meaning of patriotism Patriotism has (በአማርኛ)
concepts.simple_definition_amharic: [አማርኛ] The meaning of patriotism Patriotism has originated from the Latin term ‘patria’ which means father land (ይህ ትርጓሜ በኢትዮጵያ የ10ኛ ክፍል ሥርዓተ-ትምህርት መሠረት የተዘጋጀ ነው)።
concepts.deep_explanation_amharic: [አማርኛ ማብራሪያ] Therefore, patriotism is a sentiment; a psychological attachment to one’s nation — ይህ ጽንሰ-ሐሳብ ተማሪዎች በክፍል ውስጥ የተማሩትን በቀላሉ እንዲረዱ ይረዳቸዋል።
concepts.real_example_amharic: [አማርኛ] በገጽ 149 ላይ ያለውን ተግባራዊ ምሳሌ ይመልከቱ።
concepts.common_confusion_amharic: [አማርኛ] ተማሪዎች ይህንን ጽንሰ-ሐሳብ ከሌሎች ተዛማጅ ርዕሶች ጋር ሊያደናግሩ ይችላሉ።

concepts.name: Traditional Patriotism Traditional Patri
concepts.simple_definition: Traditional patriotism Traditional patriotism refers to some one’s readiness to give his or her life for the mother land
concepts.deep_explanation: Such patriots celebrate a particularistic sense of belonging to a nation or a country

concepts.name: Values That Exist In The Din Of The Youn
concepts.simple_definition: values that exist in the din of the younger generation to fight for the country should be followed by the current generation despite the different scenarios in the past and the present
concepts.deep_explanation: In the building of an independent nation in all aspects, a strong and powerful spirit of patriotism must be in every individual especially the younger generation who will inherit and lead the development of the country
